title: Siam Hossain Portfolio Redesign — Spec Sheet
open_notes: Open Main.dc.html first — it's the canonical hub. Then walk the list below.

rows.title: D1 · Hub desktop — LIGHT, full length
rows.notes: The canonical board. Walks the new section order at desktop width: top bar → hero (5-cell spec) → #work (with pipeline tile) → #experience (year ruler, CV-aligned rows, certs) → #skills (3×3 with evidence chips) → #practice (Codolio 2000+ + ledger + AI topics) → #about → #contact (inverse) → footer.

rows.title: A0 · Tokens & components
rows.notes: Tokens tables (light + dark), type ramp (display, h2, body, label, big numbers), buttons, chips, tiles, inverse tile, popover shape.

rows.title: D2 · Hub hero — DARK
rows.notes: Same hero, dark theme. Same data, just inverted. Used in code as the second `[data-theme]` state.

rows.title: D3 · Work states
rows.notes: Four panels: (1) card hover fill, (2) filtered grid, (3) Index view, (4) skill→project trace from the evidence popover (clicking 'React · 4 projects' highlights matching projects in Work).

rows.title: D4 · Overlays
rows.notes: Three overlays: evidence popover anchored to a chip; AIUB Notice Bot pipeline with a step focused + a row inspector; ⌘K command menu.

rows.title: D5 · POS case study — desktop
rows.notes: Full case-study template. Header bento (chip/year · H1 · sub · links · ROLE/STACK/SCOPE/STATUS dl) · hero media · label|content chapter rows · gallery engine (filmstrip + prev/next) · Next case study pager · reading-progress bar.

rows.title: D6 · Case-study headers (5 pages)
rows.notes: automation.html header rendered in dark. ai-dev, ecommerce, wpdev, websites all in light, stacked for comparison.

rows.title: P1 · Phone hero — 390×844 — LIGHT
rows.notes: Hero in light theme with the menu button, theme button, and a sticky bottom action bar (Email · Copy · CV).

rows.title: P3 · Phone hub — full length
rows.notes: Phone scroll: hero, work filter chips + work cards collapsed to 3, skills 2×2, practice ledger table, contact, sticky action bar.

rows.title: P4 · Phone states
rows.notes: Three phone states: menu sheet (rises from bottom), sticky action bar visible once hero is past, bottom-sheet evidence popover for skill chips.

rows.title: P5 · POS case study — phone
rows.notes: Case-study template on phone. Same header bento shape, simpler gallery with horizontal swipe, sticky action bar.

rows.title: S1 · Theme reveal (5-frame strip)
rows.notes: Click toggle → View Transition circle expands from toggle rect over ~520ms; new theme paints under the circle on unmount. FF fallback: instant.

rows.title: S2 · Card → case morph
rows.notes: Shared view-transition-name on hub card and case H1 (Chrome/Safari). Firefox falls back to plain navigation.

rows.title: S3 · Pipeline packet
rows.notes: 5-stage WAAPI packet. 2 cycles per render. Pause/Replay. Reduced-motion: instant end-to-end, no movement.

rows.title: S4 · Filter reflow
rows.notes: Filter change fades non-matching cards, expands matched cards, rewrites URL to ?filter=ai. Names only set during the transition to avoid duplicate-name warnings.

design_tokens.look: warm stone 'datasheet', 1px hairlines, no shadows, no gradients
design_tokens.motion: View Transitions · Popover API · no WebGL · no preloader · no cursor/magnetic/tilt effects

files_to_remove: mode toggle, boot, glitch, terminal, SKILL_LEVELS / animateSkillMeters in js/script.js (≈ lines 208–597)
[HACKER.exe] buttons, scanline/boot/terminal trailing blocks in every HTML page
files_to_add_or_rewrite: shared css/style.css with two themes + legacy aliases
shared js/script.js with guarded modules (theme, copy, clock, filter, evidence/trace, pipeline, ledger, gallery, view transitions, ⌘K)
one shared case-study template applied to all 6 case pages
new index.html in the new section order with the Spec Sheet hub layout

verification.kept_words: HackerRank (the certification platform) is not removed.

notes_for_reviewer: No emoji anywhere except as plain Unicode glyphs (e.g. ⌘ / ☀) used for iconography, not decoration.
No gradients, no left-border cards, no shadows — only 1px hairlines.
All buttons are real <button> elements; all CTAs that look like buttons are real <a>.
Dark mode is shown by a [data-theme='dark'] attr on the root; pages flip via JS and persist via localStorage.
Storyboards are 5-frame strips to illustrate motion; the actual runtime is one continuous tween.
